hints: Protocol requirements act like abstract methods; the extension holds the shared algorithm.

jsBridge: Swift has no `abstract` keyword (TS does). The idiomatic replacement is a protocol with required members plus an extension with the template method. The compiler then enforces the "abstract" parts.

compass.q: TS `abstract class Report { abstract rows(): string[] }`: what does the Swift protocol + extension approach do better or worse?
